newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randfontein job cuts on hold pending review.
newsitem.headline: Randfontein job cuts on hold pending review.

text.p: JCI Ltd said on Wednesday the planned retrenchments of more than 4,000 workers at its Randfontein Estates Gold Mining Co Ltd had been put on hold pending a review.
"It has been suspended over the last couple of days pending a review of the situation," a JCI spokesman said.
JCI said last week that it planned to shed between 3,400 and 4,100 jobs at Randfontein and reduce tonnage throughput as part of a far-reaching restructuring programme.

Randfontein produced 4,392 kg of gold in the March quarter compared to 5,100 kg in the December quarter. It plunged into a loss of 2.86 million rand, well down on the previous quarter's 43.83 million rand profit.
At the time of reporting the March quarter the mine announced that these results could lead to a further labour retructuring programme.
The National Union of Mineworkers (NUM) said on Tuesday that talks with JCI on retrenchment packages were underway.
